entities.label: Uzbekistan environmental atlas (source metadata)
entities.description: Facts taken verbatim from the source packages: titles, file sizes, formats, package membership.

entities.label: Portal curator
entities.description: A human reviewer who promotes, corrects or rejects proposals. Curator decisions are the training labels for the next model.

entities.label: Geospatial extraction pipeline
entities.description: Measured facts produced by the conversion scripts: geometry type, feature counts, bounding boxes, field names, derivation lineage.

entities.label: HydroSHEDS
entities.agentVersion: HydroRIVERS v1.0 / HydroLAKES v1.0 / HydroBASINS v1.c
entities.description: Global hydrographic reference data developed by WWF and partners. Stable river, lake and basin identifiers are preserved in the Uzbekistan relationship database together with native downstream routing and Pfafstetter hierarchy.

entities.label: Character n-gram similarity model v1
entities.description: TF-IDF character n-gram model over bilingual titles and field names. Proposes observed properties, analysis concepts and related datasets with calibrated confidence. Replaceable by a satellite-embedding or language-model backend without changing the graph contract.

entities.label: OpenStreetMap contributors (Geofabrik extract)
entities.description: Crowd-sourced mapping, extracted for Uzbekistan and redistributed by Geofabrik via mapcruzin.com. Licensed ODbL 1.0, which requires attribution and share-alike on derived databases; the licence is recorded on every dataset from this source.

entities.label: Lexical seeding rules v1
entities.description: Deterministic term matching over English and Russian titles. Produces the weak-supervision seed for semantic predicates; never publishes as asserted on its own above the review threshold.

entities.label: Uzhydromet
entities.description: The national hydrometeorological service. Source of the station climate series, the river-gauge inventory and the agricultural statistics transferred in the same delivery.

entities.label: State cadastre extraction (UZKAD)
entities.description: Parcel-level land administration data extracted from the national cadastre system in August 2025. Access is restricted; the geometry is authoritative for legal land units, not for physical land cover.

entities.label: HydroBASINS level-12 catchments — Uzbekistan
entities.description: Level-12 Pfafstetter catchments referenced by the Uzbekistan river and lake relationship database.

entities.label: HydroLAKES water bodies — Uzbekistan
entities.description: Lakes and reservoirs intersecting Uzbekistan, with native HydroLAKES identifiers and measured links to HydroBASINS level-12 catchments.

entities.label: HydroRIVERS river network — Uzbekistan
entities.description: Hydrologically routed river reaches intersecting Uzbekistan, clipped to the national boundary while preserving native HydroRIVERS identifiers and downstream links.

entities.label: Land-cover training samples
entities.description: 198,615 labelled polygons across 11 classes, assembled from the per-class cadastre exports. The training asset for a supervised land-cover model; class balance is extreme, so it must be sampled rather than used as-is.

entities.label: Meteorological station network
entities.description: 86 stations. The .dbf carries no encoding declaration and must be read as cp1251 or the names arrive as mojibake. Station numbers are six-digit operator codes, not the five-digit WMO indices used by the climate workbooks, so the two cannot be joined until a crosswalk is supplied.

entities.label: River gauge inventory
entities.description: Gauge list with coordinates, so the discharge series can be mapped. This is the missing link between the hydrological tables and the river network.

entities.label: Station air-temperature series
entities.description: One sheet per station, named '<WMO index> <station>', each a Years x months matrix running October to September. Roughly 70 stations across seven workbooks: the ground truth the atlas temperature trend rasters were interpolated from.

entities.label: Survey responses (Uzhydromet transfer)
entities.description: Questionnaire returns on services, income and demographics. Catalogued so the delivery is fully accounted for, and marked internal: it is neither environmental data nor safe to publish without a disclosure review.
